name: new-dashboard-texture-selection
purpose: Curated texture sources from the legacy asset repository for the new Project Nightmare visual direction.
rule: Only textures that support the new retrowave / industrial-horror dashboard and future environments are selected. No legacy dashboard artwork or effects are copied.

excluded.reason: not part of the first retrowave-industrial texture pass

note: The selected source files are Git LFS binaries. The connected GitHub file interface can read their LFS metadata but cannot transfer binary LFS objects into the new repository. Do not create fake placeholder ZIPs or LFS pointers in the new asset library.
